We also break down the teaser frame by frame, point out possible plot holes, and analyze whether audiences are still interested in these kinds of spy-action films. Along the way, we review some of the funniest memes, reactions, and social media meltdowns related to the teaser. Finally, we compare Alpha with Dhurandhar to see which film creates a stronger impact. So sit back, relax, and enjoy the video.
